purpose: Test whether the quality-conservative one-B70 Qwen3.8 Q8_0 package can fit and benefit from the same-revision external Q4_0 MTP draft without changing target output.

fixed_profile.gpu: one Intel Arc Pro B70, physical GPU 0
fixed_profile.transport: native raw /completion with returned token IDs

screen.headline_formula: median within each class, then median of six class medians

decision_rule.fit_failure: A device-allocation or startup failure is a measured unsupported-profile result and authorizes no speed value.
decision_rule.screen_only: No one-server screen value is a public package headline or a new homepage row.
decision_rule.winner: Highest class-balanced rate among arms that pass every workload, cache, natural-stop/length, canary, positive-draft-counter, and complete-token-array MTP0-oracle gate.
decision_rule.promotion: Run the winner on a second fresh server and promote only the median of both class-balanced medians when all twelve arrays also match between fresh MTP servers.
decision_rule.no_transfer: No result transfers to 32K, concurrency, TP2, Q4 target, Q8 draft, another runtime, or another model revision.
